purpose: Section 15: pre-register a stratified sample of ground-truth units for the independent taxonomy-reproducibility study, drawn from all 4 frozen datasets (not limited to the historical 51-case DSGR sample, to avoid over-weighting historical disagreements), covering the required ~19 strata, before any adjudicator sees anything.

methodology.step1_dataExtraction: A read-only, zero-cost, deterministic-only (no live judge, no network) sweep of all 4 frozen datasets was run via the existing runEvaluationV2() engine (fwrg/lsb/conmed via the legacy-package adapter, DSGR via the dsgr adapter), producing a manifest of all 1,115 ground-truth units with mechanical stratum-membership tags derived from each unit's own deterministic evaluation signals (matchStatus, compiled-vs-inventory-only candidate presence, safety-flag presence, sibling/chapeau shape via the same splitSectionRef() the production I_CLAIM_IDENTITY dimension uses, figure/condition/exception/cross-reference counts). Per-dataset totals: fwrg=18, lsb=14, conmed=67, dsgr=1016.
step2_forcedInclusions: All 14 historical confirmed false-credit negative controls (Section 25) are force-included, so the adjudication study directly re-tests whether independent blinded reviewers also reject them - a cross-check pre-registered in 08-taxonomy-study-preregistration.json's falseCreditAndSafetyCrossChecks.

All 18 FWRG and all 14 LSB ground-truth units are force-included in full (32 units) - both datasets are small enough that full coverage is more informative than a partial draw, and their drafting styles (sponsor greater-of-basket vs. ABL Payment-Conditions-gated) are architecturally distinct.
methodology.step3_conmedSupplement: CONMED (67 units, entirely UNREPRESENTED/discovery-only under the current deterministic engine, zero compiled representation layer) was under-selected by the generic per-stratum fill because its strata mostly duplicate what FWRG/LSB already cover densely. 14 CONMED units were explicitly force-added to preserve its architecturally distinct evidence: its 19-basket/16-basket enumerated chapeau structures (7.2, 7.3, 7.6, 7.8 and 4 of their sibling sub-baskets), its amendment-heavy documents c/d (4 units), and one guaranty-creation unit from document b.
methodology.step4_genericStratumFill: For each of the remaining 17 non-empty strata (1-6, 8, 10-19), up to 4 additional NOT-yet-selected units were added from the combined CONMED+DSGR pool, preferring CONMED first (to keep boosting its thin representation), then higher materiality (CRITICAL > MATERIAL > REVIEW_UNCERTAIN > INFORMATIONAL), in a fixed deterministic tie-break order (dataset key, then gtUnitId) so the selection is exactly reproducible from the frozen manifest.
methodology.step5_contradictoryCoverage: matchStatus=CONTRADICTORY is a real, important disposition category (a confident wrong assertion, arguably more dangerous than silence) that does not correspond to any of the 19 requested strata. Up to 2 additional CONTRADICTORY-disposition units per dataset were added where not already selected, so adjudicators are also tested on distinguishing CONTRADICTORY_REPRESENTATION from the silent/discovery states.
methodology.reproducibilityOfSelection: The selection script (deterministic, seeded only by fixed sort keys, no randomness) is preserved at docs/evaluation-v2-final-resolution/_taxonomy-sample-build-script.py for audit; re-running it against the frozen manifest hash below reproduces the identical 65-case list.

structuralFindingsDuringSampling.name: ambiguous
structuralFindingsDuringSampling.finding: V2's deterministic AMBIGUOUS matchStatus requires >=2 mutually-irreconcilable SUBSTANTIVE (compiled) full matches (matching.ts). This literally never occurs across all 1,115 ground-truth units in the 4 frozen datasets, even though DSGR's raw production coverage data separately records 139 AMBIGUOUS_MATCH candidate-level coverage states - those candidates get accountingRole=HONEST_UNRESOLVED at the unit level (folded into strata 5/8), not a unit-level AMBIGUOUS disposition. This is disclosed as evidence for the ontology-reproducibility analysis (13/14), not treated as a sampling gap: no case exists to sample.
structuralFindingsDuringSampling.sampleAction: Zero cases selected for this stratum; adjudicators may still independently assign AMBIGUOUS to any sampled case if the evidence in front of them genuinely supports it under the rubric's own evidence-triggered override - this only means the mechanical PRE-selection could not target this label using V2's own deterministic signal.

structuralFindingsDuringSampling.name: exact_verified
structuralFindingsDuringSampling.finding: matchedCandidateIds (the set V2 treats as 'the' representation) can only ever contain accountingRole=SUBSTANTIVE_REPRESENTATION candidates; verification-type candidates are always accountingRole=SAFETY_FLAG and never enter matchedCandidateIds, and DSGR's own frozen coverage run recorded zero FULLY_REPRESENTED_VERIFIED entries system-wide. No ground-truth unit in any of the 4 frozen deterministic runs can currently satisfy 'fully represented AND independently verified' as V2's own engine defines it. This is a significant, evidence-backed finding carried forward into 14-product-actionability-analysis.json: it suggests the VERIFIED_SEMANTIC_REPRESENTATION / SEMANTICALLY_REPRESENTED_UNVERIFIED distinction may be currently unreachable by the pipeline's own architecture, independent of any taxonomy-reproducibility question.
structuralFindingsDuringSampling.sampleAction: Zero cases selected for this stratum for the same reason as stratum 7.

sampleComposition.stratum6Disclosure: Stratum 6 (unsupported/silent - a dangerous UNREPRESENTED unit with zero flag AND zero inventory-level candidate anywhere) has exactly 1 available case system-wide (lsb-def-abl-notes-priority-collateral) - the same case used as the worked example in this stratum's own extraction rule. This reflects genuine sparsity of the most-dangerous state in these 4 frozen datasets (most UNREPRESENTED units still carry SOME inventory-only or safety-flag candidate nearby), not a sampling defect.

note_dsgrSampleIsNotExhaustive: DSGR contributes 18 of its 1,016 units (14 false-credit controls + 4 generic-fill additions) - a small fraction of the full package, but a deliberately targeted one (every historical false-credit control, plus the stratum gaps FWRG/LSB/CONMED could not fill). This is NOT the same 51-case sample used in Phase 3F.1.5/3F.1.5.1/3F.1.5.2 - it overlaps only on the 14 false-credit controls (which were already part of that historical sample) and is otherwise a fresh draw, satisfying Section 15's 'not limited to the existing 51 cases' requirement.
nextStep: docs/evaluation-v2-final-resolution/09/10/11-adjudicator-{a,b,c}-results.json will be produced by three independently-dispatched, mutually-isolated adjudicators working from a BLINDED evidence packet for exactly these 65 frozen case IDs (ground-truth text/description + full candidate-pool excerpts + structural metadata, with V2's own disposition/matchedCandidateIds/matchStatus fields stripped) plus 06-taxonomy-operational-rubric.json. The blinded packet and a separately-sealed (adjudicator-inaccessible) file carrying V2's actual dispositions for later comparison (19-v2-vs-independent-consensus.json) will be built next and are not part of this frozen sample definition.
